dict.string: FolderFlow watches your Downloads folder so it can organize new files with the rules you create. Your files never leave your Mac.
FolderFlow watches your Desktop so it can organize new files with the rules you create. Your files never leave your Mac.
FolderFlow watches your Documents folder so it can organize new files with the rules you create. Your files never leave your Mac.
FolderFlow needs access to folders you chose on external drives to organize them. Your files never leave your Mac.
FolderFlow needs access to folders you chose on network drives to organize them. Your files never leave your Mac.
